blueprint.overview: Plan a brick-built LEGO-style minifigure holding a blue lightsaber. Build as 4 major sub-assemblies: legs/base, torso/robe, head+hair, and lightsaber/arms cluster. Colors aren’t provided, so use light/white for robes, tan/light for face/hands, yellow/tan for hair, and gray/blue for saber where possible.

subassemblies.name: Legs & feet base
subassemblies.description: 1 compact lower-body block: 2 feet, 2 legs, and 1 hip/waist connection point. Use a 4x4-ish footprint with a centered top stud area to attach the torso. Suggest stacking plates to create two forward feet and a slight stance (2 feet blocks, 1 pelvis block).

subassemblies.name: Torso & white tunic
subassemblies.description: 1 torso block with layered robe look: 1 chest core, 1 belt band around the waist, and 1 small front-knot/pouch detail. Build a 4-stud-wide chest tapering to the waist using stacked bricks/plates; add a thin belt stripe (1 layer) and a centered buckle/pouch bump (1 small piece).

subassemblies.name: Head + hair
subassemblies.description: 1 head: 1 face cylinder/brick-built head with 2 eyes and 1 mouth suggested via small dark plates/studs; 1 shaggy hair mass as a rounded cap using curved slopes/tiles layered front-to-back (approx. 6–10 curved elements).

subassemblies.name: Arms + lightsaber
subassemblies.description: 2 arms in a ‘both-hands-on-hilt’ pose plus 1 lightsaber: build 2 forearms angled inward, 2 hands meeting at center, 1 hilt (short gray stack), and 1 blade (long thin blue stack). Use hinge/clip-like parts if available; otherwise approximate with stepped plates to angle arms inward and a straight vertical/diagonal blade.
subassemblies.imageRegion: right half, from chest to top-right
